validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed, strong. MEED (the row's own cited source) explicitly names this segment as Package 7 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3): 'Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-6 to EWPS-8, covering 340km.' url_verifier confirmed the page returns 200 and contains the tokens 'EWPS-6 to EWPS-8', '340', and '56-inch'; WebFetch returned the verbatim Package 7 sentence. MGS-3 is independently corroborated as a real, awarded, under-construction ~$8.8-10bn / 4,153 km program by JPT/SPE (OK 200, 'Master Gas System'+'2028') and Pipeline Technology Journal (OK 200). Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct - a 56-inch east-west gas transmission trunk on the national Master Gas System backbone; commodity gas; PipelineType transmission. Not gathering/process/lateral. DUPLICATE CHECK: P6726 ('EWPS-6-EWPS-8 "4"', also 170 km, 56 in) is the PARALLEL line 4 of the same EWPS-6->EWPS-8 corridor. MEED names 'pipelines three and four' (two physical lines), so P6725 (line 3) and P6726 (line 4) are two real parallel pipes, NOT a double-count - identical structure to the confirmed P6723/P6724 (EWPS-4->EWPS-6) pair. No other roster PID shares the EWPS-6->EWPS-8 corridor, so no duplicate. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct - Aramco owns/operates the Master Gas System. Fuel Gas correct. Endpoints EWPS-6 (East-West Pump Station 6) -> EWPS-8 within Saudi Arabia; province not stated at segment level, left unfilled (no fabrication). SPEC: Diameter 56 in explicitly confirmed by MEED. LengthKnown 170 km is a caveat - the source states 340 km for the PAIR of lines (3 and 4); GEM split it 170+170, arithmetically consistent (170x2=340) and a defensible per-line modeling choice, so no material disagreement, but the 170 figure is inferred rather than directly sourced. Capacity blank and left blank - MGS-3 adds ~3.2 bscfd across 4,153 km total; no defensible per-segment capacity, so not fabricated. StartYear1 2028 matches the project's Q4 2028 completion target.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status 'construction' still correct. MGS-3 EPC contracts (incl. Package 7, EWPS-6->EWPS-8) were awarded 2024; construction commenced Q2 2024; target completion Q4 2028 (MEED, JPT/SPE). Program-wide active-construction evidence into 2025: Pipeline Technology Journal reports L&T completed a 120 km 56-inch section of MGS-3 (Package 8) and mobilized on a further ~241 km section, and YSG completed Package 8 site buildings as of April 2025 - the program is mid-construction, not stalled. No independent evidence that the EWPS-6->EWPS-8 lines specifically are complete/started-up or delayed, so still 'construction', not 'operating'. Well under any dormancy threshold (awarded 2024, active 2025). StartYear1 2028 matches the Q4 2028 completion target. Aramco's own 2024 press release (aramco.com/...25bn-contract-awards) would be a further corroborating source but ReadTimeout'd in url_verifier, so it is intentionally NOT cited.
